name: Edit NPC Behavior Command Blueprint
description: Blueprint defining the structure for the 'edit_npc_behavior' command.
author: NeoEngine v1

command.name: edit_npc_behavior
command.description: Modifies the behavior parameters or schedule of an NPC.

parameters.name: npc_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the NPC.

parameters.name: new_behavior_type
parameters.description: Optional: Change the NPC's behavior type (e.g., state_machine, behavior_tree).

parameters.name: new_mood
parameters.description: Optional: Set a new default mood for the NPC.

parameters.name: new_schedule
parameters.description: Optional: Replace the NPC's daily schedule.

start_time.description: Start time in seconds from day start (0-86400)

end_time.description: End time in seconds from day start (0-86400)
